args: RETURN {name: 'Alice', age: 30, active: true} AS person_map
RETURN type(42) AS int_type, type('text') AS string_type, type(true) AS bool_type, type([1,2,3]) AS list_type
MATCH (n:TypeTest) RETURN exists(n.existing_prop) AS has_prop, exists(n.missing_prop) AS missing_prop
RETURN toString(42) AS int_to_string, toString(3.14) AS float_to_string, toString(true) AS bool_to_string
RETURN toInteger('42') AS string_to_int, toInteger(3.14) AS float_to_int, toInteger(true) AS bool_to_int
RETURN toFloat('3.14') AS string_to_float, toFloat(42) AS int_to_float
RETURN toBoolean('true') AS string_to_bool, toBoolean(1) AS int_to_bool, toBoolean(0) AS zero_to_bool
RETURN size([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]) AS list_size, size([]) AS empty_size, size('hello') AS string_size
RETURN keys({name: 'Alice', age: 30, active: true}) AS map_keys
RETURN size({a: 1, b: 2, c: 3}) AS map_size
MATCH (n:TypeNode) RETURN n.int_prop AS int_val, n.string_prop AS string_val, n.bool_prop AS bool_val, n.list_prop AS list_val, n.map_prop AS map_val

MATCH (n) WHERE 
  n:TypeTest OR n:TypeNode OR n:DynamicTest
DETACH DELETE n
